neighbours.label: words expressing a connection between places or things (linking, links, connecting, between, among)
fire: A new rail tunnel linking the two islands is due to open next year.
The old footbridge connecting the village to the station was finally repaired.
A fast ferry service links the harbor with the towns along the coast.
Trade between the two regions grew quickly after the road was paved.
The highway connecting the port and the capital is often jammed.
Cables linking the data centers run under the sea floor.
A narrow pass between the mountains was the only route north.
The canal links the river to the lake, saving boats a long detour.
quiet: A new rail tunnel under the mountain is due to open next year.
The old footbridge in the village was finally repaired.
A fast ferry service leaves the harbor every hour in summer.
Trade in the region grew quickly after the road was paved.
The highway near the port is often jammed.
Cables for the data centers are stored in a warehouse.
A narrow pass in the mountains was closed by snow.
The canal is full of boats in summer, and the water is calm.

notes: Top tokens: between x4, linking x3, links x2, among x2, connecting x2 (top example ' which' in 'order in which'). Near misses keep transport/infrastructure topics without a connection word.
